notes: Site profile: the recipe at tp4-ring on the stock 4 KiB kernel (7.0.0-1025-nvidia, no memory saver), with control traffic on the ring0 node addresses (10.10.100.x) because the nodes have no wired management network. Start it with --unqualified-shape. It serves 16 concurrent sequences (CUDA graphs up to 96 rows, long-prefill threshold 16384-96) instead of the recipe's 32, keeping the recipe's 16.5 GiB KV pool. The GLP steering block is unset (its repository is gated). It uses the promoted upstream lock: the 1120 patch heads reproduce on this host.
